title: Chapter 6277: My Dao Is Not Lonely

Chapter 6277: My Dao Is Not Lonely

Chapter 6277: My Dao Is Not Lonely

“How wonderful, Fellow Daoist.” An ethereal and ancient voice within the radiance responded, seemingly coming from the past: “You have surpassed and put me to shame.”

Everyone listened attentively and pondered the possibility of Everlasting Jiang surpassing the creator of the everlasting path. This was beyond a disciple surpassing their master - truly a feat worthy of admiration.

“It is due to the effort and contribution of those before me.” Everlasting Jiang said: “You started it all, Senior, I merely added floral embroideries to fine silk.”

All eyes were on these apex beings. Some gleamed with hope and anticipation.

“It is an honor to share this glorious moment.” Fardao sighed and said.

Millions and more have embarked on the path he paved. Now that people have caught up to him, he and his dao are no longer lonely. This was a joyous occasion for the creator.

“The time is now and I require your help, Senior. Shall we take a look at the road ahead?” Everlasting Jiang asked politely.

“How may I be of assistance?” Fardao didn’t refuse.

“Let us go all out.” Everlasting Jiang suggested: “Show each other what we have learned regarding the return path to break the final barricade, I need your wisdom and experience, Senior.”

Everyone gasped emotionally. Someone whispered: “Dao enlightenment through fighting?”

“I think so.” The big shots were moved.

Everlasting Jiang saw a glimmer of hope and wanted to break through to the realm equivalent to supreme overlords.

However, he couldn’t grasp it yet, hence the need to excavate further with Fardao’s experience and wisdom.

“Only the gate of death will make one reach their limit, enough to grasp the opportunity.” Fardao understood.

Words weren’t necessary since they had reached the path’s apex long enough to know what was next.

“Is it going to be a fight to the death?” Someone asked.

“They’re not on the same side. In fact, they’re enemies.” A big shot said.

God Frontier supported Zhan Sansheng because according to the legends during the era of Moshi, Fardao lost to him.

Although it wasn’t a staunch supporter like Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect or Trinity Kingdom, it had done many things for Zhan Sansheng’s camp. This included fighting Desolate Frontier.

“The dao has no border.” An emperor said. Factions did not matter when it came to potential cultivation improvement.

“Thus we must go all out, you and me, Senior.” Everlasting Jiang’s voice echoed.

“Very well.” Fardao nodded and said: “Seize our destiny amidst death, let us pave the way.”

Everyone felt a chill coursing down their spine after hearing his nonchalant response - a stark contrast to the monumental event.

Some desolate gods were moved to tears because the two combatants were at the apex already. Their lives were incredibly precious; both had done everything to stay alive. Today, they willingly risked it all to pave the way for the next journey.

“The dao is more important than life itself.” A desolate god said with tears in his eyes: “The wise sages will guide us, please accept my token of gratitude.”

With that, he prostrated on the ground. His action resonated across the crowd and other desolate gods followed suit. These two have never stopped trying to improve this path and have contributed more than anyone else.

“To an ancient battlefield.” Everlasting Jiang laughed heartily, causing the stars to shake: “It is an honor to be in your company, Senior. My life was not wasted.”

“My dao is not lonely because it has you. The honor is mine.” Fardao laughed as well.

No one spoke because they didn’t wish to disturb this historical event. Tears inadvertently streamed down their cheeks.

Characters such as Fardao and Everlasting Jiang made this world more colorful. This light illuminated the hearts.

This had nothing to do with power and authority, only a pure and unending yearning for the dao. It exceeded everything - desires and temptations.

They were no longer Fardao and Everlasting Jiang at this very moment, only serving as pioneers.

“To the battlefield!” Fardao took one step forward and emerged again in a different realm. Rumor has it immortals had fought here before.

He didn’t bother looking back at the world or his sect, determined to move his dao forward.
